original_test_intent: Measure the approved DCGM GPU memory-bandwidth path and confirm every target meets a topology/clock-specific throughput floor without integrity or health regression.
original_method: Pin driver/DCGM and script; map GPUs, memory type/capacity, clocks/power state and topology; resolve source level 4 versus bandwidth level 8 plus transfer patterns; baseline throughput, memory/ECC/XID/PCIe/thermal/power; drain workloads, preserve logs, run once with monitoring; compare per-GPU bandwidth/tolerance and restore state.
manual_activity: GPU performance owner selects scope and approves per-platform bandwidth floors/tolerance, patterns and health limits; operator drains workloads and controls state/recovery.
required_inputs: Per-GPU topology, memory and clock/power baseline
Numeric bandwidth floors/tolerance and integrity rules
Isolation, OOB, thermal/power/error stops and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run against live unapproved contexts
Preserve full throughput and error evidence
Abort on health or integrity anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Evaluate each GPU and health delta
Restore runtime and report without verdict

review_improvement: Adds the numeric, per-GPU throughput oracle required by the item instead of treating a generic subtest PASS as performance evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Bandwidth is meaningful only with units, transfer shape, clocks/power state and topology held constant. An internal PASS can hide a large performance regression, while good throughput can coexist with ECC or thermal faults; both numeric performance and health integrity must pass together.
